dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Operational overview for your Norgoth workspace.

campaignTable.title: Campaign Snapshot
campaignTable.description: Recent campaign activity across active and draft operations.

campaignsPage.title: Campaign Messaging
campaignsPage.description: Create, monitor, and control outreach operations across your workspace.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.description: Manage workspace preferences and system-wide configuration.
settingsPage.languageDescription: Choose the default interface language for your current workspace session.

campaignDetail.title: Campaign Detail
campaignDetail.description: Review campaign performance, message state, and operational risks.

campaignWizard.newCampaignDescription: Create and configure a new messaging campaign.
campaignWizard.basicsDescription: Define the identity and purpose of this campaign.
campaignWizard.basicsSummary: This step defines the base identity of the campaign before audience and validation are configured.
campaignWizard.audienceDescription: Define who should be included or excluded from this campaign.
campaignWizard.safeAudienceNote: Audience constraints are applied before validation and delivery.
campaignWizard.messageDescription: Define the message content and preview how it will appear.
campaignWizard.messagePreviewNote: Preview updates based on your current message input.
campaignWizard.validationDescription: Review audience safety, delivery estimates, and risk level before launch.
campaignWizard.validationSafeNote: Audience exclusions and delivery checks were applied to produce this estimate.
campaignWizard.launchDescription: Choose how and when this campaign should start.
campaignWizard.launchNote: This summary reflects the current wizard state before execution.

memberVerification.title: Member Verification
memberVerification.description: Screens members joining your server and applies your verification policy before granting access.
memberVerification.usage: Open Verification Settings to configure roles, channels, risk checks, High Risk Servers, and Whitelisted Users.

manualVerification.title: Manual Verification
manualVerification.description: Members flagged by your risk policy — such as belonging to a configured High Risk Server — wait here for a human decision.
manualVerification.usage: Open a member's review to see the risk analysis and trigger, then Approve to grant access or Deny to keep them unverified.

leveling.title: Levels & Activity
leveling.description: Rewards member activity with XP and levels earned from messages and voice, with optional role rewards.
leveling.usage: Tune XP rates and the multiplier, configure level-up announcements, and add role rewards below.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboards
leaderboard.description: Ranks members by Text XP, Voice XP, or All-Time net upvotes from Top Trending.
leaderboard.usage: Switch between Text XP, Voice XP, and Top Upvote tabs here. Configure Top Trending to populate net upvote rankings.

feedChannels.title: Top Trending
feedChannels.description: Tracks upvote and downvote reactions on source messages and mirrors top posts into Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and All-Time Top Trending channels.
feedChannels.usage: Pick upvote/downvote emojis and source channels, assign a destination for each UTC window, then enable Top Trending from the header. Use Repair to recreate missing channels and restore posts. Set the Feed Category and Refresh Interval below the cards. The Next Refresh countdown shows time until the next automatic sync.

autoModeration.title: Auto-Moderation
autoModeration.description: Automatically enforces content rules on messages such as banned words, spam, invites, and mass mentions.
autoModeration.usage: Configure individual rules below, then enable Auto-Moderation from the page header.

raidProtection.title: Raid Protection
raidProtection.description: Detects and mitigates coordinated join raids and rapid suspicious activity.
raidProtection.usage: Set join thresholds and automatic responses, then enable protection from the header.

honeypot.title: Honeypot
honeypot.description: Traps and flags malicious accounts using hidden bait channels or roles.
honeypot.usage: Configure the trap and warning message (TinyMCE + Embed Library), then enable the honeypot from the header.
honeypot.alertActive: The honeypot is active. Legitimate members must be warned never to use the trap channel. Administrators and configured exemptions are protected. Posting may cause immediate automated punishment. Triggers are recorded through Logging Configurations (Security event group).
honeypot.alertInactive: The honeypot trap is currently inactive. Enable it from the header to start catching spam bots. Legitimate members must still be warned never to use the trap channel once it is enabled.

selfAssignableRoles.title: Self-Assignable Roles
selfAssignableRoles.description: Lets members pick their own roles from a published message using buttons, a dropdown, or reactions.
selfAssignableRoles.usage: Create the message in Embed Library first, then add a menu here and attach role controls to that published message.

welcomeLeave.title: Welcome & Leave
welcomeLeave.description: Sends a message when members join or leave, with live delivery status and a test send.
welcomeLeave.usage: Compose the join and leave messages and choose their destination channels.

embedMessages.title: Embed Library
embedMessages.description: Create, save, and reuse rich Discord embed drafts as a central template library.
embedMessages.usage: Design an embed draft here; deploy it to a channel or reuse it from other features, then re-sync deployed copies after edits.

tickets.title: Support Tickets
tickets.description: Opens private support channels from a panel button, with transcripts saved when a ticket closes.
tickets.usage: Create a panel with its own category and log channel, publish it, and manage open tickets here.

auditLogs.title: Audit Logs
auditLogs.description: Moderation actions and server events for this guild in one timeline.
auditLogs.usage: Filter by Moderation or Server Events, set a date range, and refresh for the latest entries.

discordLogs.title: Discord Logs
discordLogs.description: Configure which Discord events are routed to log channels in your server.
discordLogs.usage: Toggle master logging from the header, then enable categories and edit each category’s channel and events.

contentNotifications.title: Content Notifications
contentNotifications.description: Announces new content from YouTube, Twitch, Kick, X, and TikTok creators directly into Discord.
contentNotifications.usage: Add creators to monitor and configure the channels that post the alerts.

campaigns.title: Campaign Messaging
campaigns.description: Create and control DM outreach campaigns to targeted members with full delivery tracking.
campaigns.usage: Build an audience and message, validate the campaign, then launch and monitor delivery.

inviteTracking.title: Invite Tracking
inviteTracking.description: Tracks who invited each member and attributes joins to specific invite links.
inviteTracking.usage: Review invite leaderboards and per-member attribution for this server.

autoRole.title: Auto Role
autoRole.description: Automatically grants a chosen role to every member who joins the server.
autoRole.usage: Pick the role to grant on join and enable it.

autoResponses.title: Auto-Responses
autoResponses.description: Replies automatically to keyword triggers with configurable match modes and cooldowns.
autoResponses.usage: Add trigger words and responses, then set match modes and per-rule cooldowns.

servers.title: Your Servers
servers.subtitle: Choose a Discord server to manage. Only servers where you have Manage Server or Administrator permission are listed.
servers.empty: No manageable servers found. Make sure you have Manage Server permission, then add Norgoth to your Discord server.
servers.errorGeneric: Could not load your Discord servers.
servers.errorAuth: Your Discord authorization expired or is missing required permissions. Reconnect Discord to continue.
servers.errorScope: Discord access is missing the guilds permission. Reconnect Discord and approve all requested scopes.
servers.errorRateLimited: Discord is rate-limiting requests. Please wait a moment and retry.
servers.errorUnavailable: Discord is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.
